evidence: Copernicus Marine documents the product as an operational global ocean physical analysis/forecast system with temperature, salinity, currents, sea-level and related fields; the legacy identifier cited by paper 716 has a documented current successor.

EDI package edi.200.6 contains high-frequency profiles including depth, temperature, dissolved oxygen, conductivity and related water-quality variables for multiple reservoirs in southwestern Virginia. It is the portal identity of the CR000334 DOI dataset.
The PASTA DOI identifies the same Carey et al. reservoir-profile dataset represented by EDI package edi.200.6; no payload was opened.
